seoTitle: WCAG 2.2 Success Criteria Explorer and Reference
metaDescription: Search all 86 WCAG 2.2 success criteria by number, name or words, filter by level, principle or new in 2.2, with links to Understanding pages.
intro: A searchable list of all WCAG 2.2 success criteria with level, opening text and a link to the W3C explanation.
why:
You often need to find the criterion for a problem quickly.

The data comes from the W3C WCAG 2.2 Recommendation. Filter by A, AA or AAA, by principle, or to the nine criteria new in 2.2. Only the opening sentence is shown, so read the full text before judging a pass.
howTo: Open the Understanding link for detail.
